cards.text: The prophet speaks up about the prophets, the men who speak to God's people in His name. And he is shaken: his heart is broken within him and all his bones tremble.

cards.question: The prophet says he's become like a drunkard, like a man overcome by wine. What does he say has done this to him?

answers.text: The LORD and His holy words

cards.text: The prophet says the land is full of adulterers. Because of the curse, the land mourns and the wilderness pastures have dried up.

cards.question: The prophet says that in the land, power is being misused.

cards.text: Now the LORD Himself speaks, and the prophets aren't the only ones He's calling out. He's found their wickedness somewhere it should never be.

cards.question: The LORD says both prophet and ___ are ungodly, and He has found their wickedness even in His ___.

cards.text: So the LORD says what's coming for them. Their path will become slick.

cards.question: On that slick path, the LORD says these prophets and priests will be driven away. Where to?

cards.text: Disaster is coming in the year of their punishment, the LORD says. Then He turns to the prophets of Samaria, who prophesied by Baal, a false god, and He calls it an offensive thing.

cards.question: The prophets of Samaria led the LORD's people Israel astray.

cards.text: Then the LORD turns to the prophets of Jerusalem, and He calls what He has seen among them a horrible thing. They commit adultery and walk in lies.

cards.question: The LORD says Jerusalem's prophets strengthen someone's hands. Whose?
Because of these prophets, the LORD says, people in Jerusalem are turning their backs on wickedness.
To the LORD, these prophets are all like ___, and the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah.

cards.text: So the LORD of Hosts says He'll feed these prophets wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts says He'll feed the prophets of Jerusalem wormwood and give them poisoned water. Why?

answers.text: Ungodliness spread from them through the land
They moved their altars out to Samaria
They stopped teaching the priests the law

cards.text: Now the LORD of Hosts has a word for the people these prophets have been prophesying to.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts tells the people to listen closely to the words of these prophets.
The LORD says these prophets are filling the people with false hopes. Where do their visions come from?

answers.text: From the priests in the temple
From the elders at the gate

cards.text: To those who despise the LORD, these prophets keep saying, "The LORD says that you will have peace," and they've got another line ready for everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart.

cards.question: What do these prophets keep telling everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart?

answers.text: No harm will come to you
Turn back while you still can
The LORD has seen your sin

cards.text: That's a smoke alarm that just yells "Everything's FINE" louder and louder. But the LORD asks which of them has stood in His council to see and hear His word, and who has given heed to His word and obeyed it.

cards.question: Then the LORD says to look: His ___ has gone out with fury, a whirlwind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.
The LORD says His anger won't turn back until He has fully accomplished the purposes of His heart.

cards.text: The LORD says, "In the days to come you will understand this clearly." Friend, it's like a recipe that only makes sense once the timer goes off and the batch comes out.

cards.question: The LORD says He sent these prophets out with their message.

cards.text: The LORD says He didn't send them, yet they ran with their message. He didn't speak to them either, yet they prophesied.

cards.question: These prophets never stood in the LORD's council. If they had, what does He say they would have done?

answers.text: Turned His people from their evil ways
Gone off to prophesy in Samaria

cards.text: And that's where we'll set this batch down for now. Hang on, friend, the LORD's not done talking about these prophets.
